links.outcome: Longitudinal change in symptom checker differential diagnosis list accuracy over 3 years
links.effect: Overall accuracy 172 (45.1%); year 1 44.3%, year 2 44.4%, year 3 47.7%; P=.85. No degradation, but no improvement over time.
links.quote: Overall, the accuracy of the differential diagnosis list created by the AI-based symptom checker was 172 (45.1%), which did not differ across the 3 years (first year: 97/219, 44.3%; second year: 32/72, 44.4%; and third year: 43/90, 47.7%; P=.85).

screen.reason: The study conducts a longitudinal evaluation/monitoring of the diagnostic accuracy and potential performance changes over a 3-year period of an AI symptom checker deployed in real-world outpatient practice.
